parts.name: Root
parts.description: The color, and the context of each control. It renders a div with role="group", named by ColorPicker.Label, and it carries the color in --color-picker-value.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable id, from which the component makes its internal ARIA ids. Give one on a server.

props.name: value
props.description:
The color, as text: a hex color, `rgb()`, `hsl()` or `hsb()`. You can bind it with
`bind:value`. The component answers in the format of `format`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The color at the start, for when you give no `value`. The default is `#000000`.

props.name: controlledValue
props.description:
Give your own code full control of the color. The component stops to write back to `value`,
and it reports only through `onChange`. Thus the parent can refuse a change.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The component calls it on each change, also on each move of a drag.

props.name: onChangeEnd
props.description:
The component calls it when a sequence of changes ends: at the release of a key, and at the
end of a drag. Use it for work that must not run on each move.

props.name: format
props.description: The text format of the value. The default is `hex`.

props.name: alpha
props.description:
Keeps an alpha in the color. The value then holds a fourth number, and `ColorPicker.Slider`
accepts the `alpha` channel. The default is off.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables each control of the picker. The controls leave the tab order.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the controls in the tab order, but the color does not change.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the color as invalid. Each control gets `aria-invalid`.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the hidden input that carries the color in a form.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of the form that the hidden input belongs to, when the picker is outside it.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name of the picker, for when there is no `ColorPicker.Label`.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of the element that gives the picker its name, in place of `ColorPicker.Label`.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: The id of the element that describes the picker, for example an error message.

props.name: children
props.description: The content: the label, the area, the sliders and the fields.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the root element.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the root element.

props.name: context
props.description: A bindable reference to the context, for a composition of your own.

dataAttributes.name: data-alpha
dataAttributes.description: Present while the picker holds an alpha.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-format
dataAttributes.description: The text format of the value: "hex", "rgb", "hsl" or "hsb".

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present while the color is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present while the picker is read-only.

parts.name: Label
parts.description: The accessible name of the picker. It renders a span, and the root points at it with aria-labelledby.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the label.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the picker is disabled.

parts.name: Area
parts.description: The square of two channels. A press in it moves the thumb there and starts a drag. It is position: relative, and it carries the position of the thumb in --color-picker-area-x and --color-picker-area-y.

props.name: xChannel
props.description: The channel of the horizontal axis. The default is `saturation`.

props.name: yChannel
props.description: The channel of the vertical axis, which counts from the bottom. The default is `brightness`.

props.name: children
props.description: The content: a `ColorPicker.AreaThumb`.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the area.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the area element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-dragging
dataAttributes.description: Present while a pointer moves the thumb.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present while the picker is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-x-channel
dataAttributes.description: The channel of the horizontal axis.

dataAttributes.name: data-y-channel
dataAttributes.description: The channel of the vertical axis.

parts.name: AreaThumb
parts.description: The handle of the square. It renders a div at a position in percent, with two native sliders in it: one for each axis. The inputs have the focus and the ARIA state.

props.name: children
props.description:
The content. As a snippet with one argument, it receives the render state: `xPercent`,
`yPercent`, `dragging` and `focused`.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the thumb.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the thumb element.

dataAttributes.name: data-axis
dataAttributes.description: The axis of one native input: "x" or "y".

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-dragging
dataAttributes.description: Present while a pointer moves the thumb.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus on the thumb must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while one of the two inputs has the focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present while the picker is read-only.

parts.name: Slider
parts.description: The track of one channel. A press on it moves the thumb there and starts a drag. It carries the two ends of the channel in --color-picker-slider-start and --color-picker-slider-end.

props.name: channel
props.description: The channel the slider moves, for example `hue` or `alpha`.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The direction of the track. The default is horizontal.

props.name: children
props.description: The content: a `ColorPicker.SliderThumb`.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the track.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the track element.

dataAttributes.name: data-channel
dataAttributes.description: The channel of the slider.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-dragging
dataAttributes.description: Present while a pointer moves the thumb.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The orientation: "horizontal" or "vertical".

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present while the picker is read-only.

parts.name: SliderThumb
parts.description: The handle of one channel. It renders a div at a position in percent, with a native slider in it. The input has the focus and the ARIA state.

props.name: children
props.description:
The content. As a snippet with one argument, it receives the render state: `percent`,
`value`, `dragging` and `focused`.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the thumb.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the thumb element.

dataAttributes.name: data-channel
dataAttributes.description: The channel of the slider.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-dragging
dataAttributes.description: Present while a pointer moves the thumb.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus on the thumb must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the native input has the focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The orientation: "horizontal" or "vertical".

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present while the picker is read-only.

parts.name: HexField
parts.description: The color as a hex text. It renders a native text input, and it reads the text at Enter and when the focus leaves.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the field.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the input element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the field has the focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present while the color is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present while the picker is read-only.

parts.name: ChannelField
parts.description: One channel as a number. It renders a native number input with the limits and the step of that channel.

props.name: channel
props.description: The channel the field holds, for example `red`.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the field.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the input element.

dataAttributes.name: data-channel
dataAttributes.description: The channel of the field.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the field has the focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present while the color is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present while the picker is read-only.

parts.name: SwatchList
parts.description: A set of colors to choose from. It renders a div with role="listbox", and each ColorPicker.Swatch in it is an option.

props.name: children
props.description: The content: one `ColorPicker.Swatch` for each color.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the list.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the list element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present while the picker is read-only.

parts.name: Swatch
parts.description: One color to choose. In a list it is an option with role="option". Outside a list it shows a color and answers nothing. The color is in --color-picker-swatch-color.

props.name: color
props.description: The color of the swatch, as text.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The name of the swatch, for the screen reader. The default is the text of its color.

props.name: children
props.description: The content. Without it, the swatch is an empty element that your CSS paints.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the swatch.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the swatch element.

dataAttributes.name: data-color
dataAttributes.description: The color of the swatch, as the consumer wrote it.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus on the swatch must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the swatch has the focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present while the color of the swatch is the color of the picker.

parts.name: Preview
parts.description: The color of now. It renders a div with the color in --color-picker-swatch-color, and it has no name and no role.

props.name: children
props.description: The content. Without it, the preview is an empty element that your CSS paints.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the preview.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the preview element.

dataAttributes.name: data-color
dataAttributes.description: The text of the color, in the format of the root.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the picker is disabled.

parts.name: EyeDropper
parts.description: Takes a color from the screen. It renders a button that opens the eye dropper of the browser.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the button.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the button element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the eye dropper of the browser is open. The browser takes up to two seconds to paint it, thus this attribute is what tells the reader that the press did something.

dataAttributes.name: data-unsupported
dataAttributes.description: Present while the browser has no eye dropper.
